## Verdict

The v0.45 managed-adopter definition of done is met for committed default-branch rollout state. All nine managed adopters have AWF 0.45.0 at schema 50 on `main`, with the retired generated Pi effort bridge absent, the repository-named generic effort-workflow skill retained, and no adopter-owned consumer of the removed AWF activity or memory protocols. Three repositories retain unrelated hosted CI failures, recorded below; they do not invalidate the AWF rollout evidence.

This report is settled closure evidence, not product policy, a release record, or a claim that every live machine and process is current.

## Method and common result

The census on 2026-08-31 used a fresh authenticated shallow clone of each GitHub default branch, GitHub repository and Actions APIs, the exact remote commit trees, and the completed adopter reports. The clone SHAs matched the GitHub API SHAs. At every remote tree:

- `.awf/awf.lock` records `awfVersion: 0.45.0` and `schemaVersion: 50`.
- `.pi/extensions/awf-effort/client.ts`, `.pi/extensions/awf-effort/index.ts`, and the repository-named Pi `using-effort` skill are absent.
- `.pi/skills/<prefix>-effort-workflow/SKILL.md` is present and directs memory-path resolution through `./awf effort show <slug>` and updates through ordinary file tools.
- A read-only `./awf effort show v045-census-missing` invocation reached the retained command and returned the expected missing-resident refusal.
- Tracked-tree residue scans found no custom import, command invocation, tool use, or consumer of the removed AWF activity and memory protocols. Pi Cockpit still implements its own generic metadata and display-suffix provider events; it does not import or consume the removed AWF bridge.

GitHub proves committed default-branch state only and cannot prove ignored journals, stale local worktrees, unpushed branches, or old Pi processes holding loaded code.

## Non-AWF findings

No adopter repository was changed to address these findings.

- `jugend-im-zentrum`: hosted run `33365692337` fails while the Docker image installs Node 20 and then `npm@latest`; npm 12 requires Node 22.22.2, 24.15.0, or 26 and refuses Node 20.20.2. Local build output also retained dependency deprecation warnings.
- `nouris`: hosted run `33364912015` fails because `typos` rejects five preexisting test strings: `Caf`, the German words `oder`, `ist`, and `deine`, and the intentional partial confirmation `DELET`. Its AWF job succeeds. The local pre-push wrapper also emitted non-failing `printf: Broken pipe` warnings after the direct native gates had passed.
- `fleet`: gates pass, but local output retains 25 React fast-refresh warnings, React Router future-flag warnings, six npm audit findings consisting of two moderate and four high findings, and govulncheck notices for one imported-package and three required-module vulnerabilities with no called vulnerability. GitHub reports 18 default-branch dependency alerts, consisting of 12 high and six moderate alerts.
- `pi-cockpit`: no unresolved product failure was reported. Complete native gates required hydrating ignored Android, Gradle, and Flutter prerequisites in the managed worktree. The hosted success covers only the AWF path-filtered workflow.
- `pi-tools`: no hosted project workflow exists. Knip emits one preexisting non-failing configuration hint. Managed-worktree verification used temporary ignored dependency and Biome setup that was removed before integration.
- `aeonseed`: no unresolved non-AWF failure was reported; hosted CI succeeds.
- `pi-science`: hosted run `33374316762` times out after 5 seconds in `packages/pi-science/tests/adapter.test.ts` while testing all fixed optimization families. The same rollout's complete local checks passed. Managed-worktree release verification first required installing ignored project-local dependencies.
- `sudoku-solver`: hosted CI succeeds; the push reported one existing moderate Dependabot vulnerability.
- `razer-kb-manager`: no unresolved non-AWF defect was reported and no hosted workflow exists. Hooks emitted only the informational notice that commit policy is disabled.

## Runtime and local-state boundary

The committed tree cannot establish live Pi compatibility by itself. Generated project extensions load only after project trust and an appropriate Pi or session restart. A process that loaded the retired extension can continue holding that code until restarted. The retained AWF profile adapter also requires a live protocol-v2 capability handshake and successful final profile registration with an independently installed compatible `pi-tools`; committed files do not prove that runtime negotiation or local model availability.

GitHub proves committed default-branch state only and cannot prove ignored journals, stale local worktrees, unpushed branches, or old Pi processes holding loaded code.
